restoration_note: This teaching is a numbered enumeration of the Great Builder's constructive works upon the bound archons — Divine Wisdom refashioning the proprium-material into a redemptive cosmos. The litany formula 'ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍ-[ordinal] ⲭⲉ ⲁ-X-[verb]' constrains nearly every ordinal head, and partial traces (ⲁⲙⲧ→third, ⲟⲩⲛ→eighth, ⲙⲏⲧ→tenth, ⲁⲍⲥⲁⲩ→sixth) lock in the count. I accept the editor's proposals throughout, with one substantive override: gap {19} = ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the Light' rather than ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ 'the Sin', because the spiritual reading identifies the captive light (not Sin) as what the Third Ambassador's revealing image discriminates *from* the archons — Sin and lust belong to the archons, not to what is extracted. Five gaps remain unrestorable: {6} (verb governing the wheels — editor herself uncertain, ⲧⲉ alone too weak), {10} (4-char start of fourth reason, no anchor), {13} (6-char clause-end, no constraint), {15} (gates of what — partial ⲛⲉⲙ...ⲉ admits multiple readings), and {27} (4-char qualifier after 'separated forth', purely speculative).

restorations.basis: Litany formula 'ⲭⲉ ⲁ X (perfect)' opens each enumerated reason; first item introduces the Great Builder.
ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'come forth' — the Builder's coming-forth opens the work.
Object of ⲁⲕⲱⲧ 'he built' before ⲛⲃⲣ̄ⲡⲉ 'anew'; building the aeon afresh from bound material is the teaching's central act.
Ordinal pattern; sequence requires 'second' here as ships are the second work.
ⲥⲉ preserved completes ⲡⲭⲥⲉ 'the Height'; ships fill the Height in the heavens — the doctrinal vessels stationed for ascent.
ⲁⲙⲧ preserved completes ⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ 'third'.
Only ⲧⲉ visible; sense uncertain even to the editor. The wheels' verb between 'ⲛⲧⲣⲟⲭⲟⲥ' and 'ⲛⲧⲛⲛⲁⲩ' could be ⲕⲱⲧⲉ 'turn' or an auxiliary, but no constraint is strong enough to commit.
Completes ⲛ̄ⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩ 'send forth'.
ⲡⲱⲛⲍ̄ 'life' — final letter restores the established lexeme.
Directional preposition before ⲡⲕⲁⲍ 'the earth'; concludes preceding clause about the wheels' descent of life to earth and worlds above.

4-char lacuna opening the fourth reason after ⲭⲉ; no surviving anchor identifies which constructive work is the fourth (likely the discrete-degrees distinction, but the precise noun cannot be recovered).
Ordinal pattern; ⲡ predicative before the gates-clause.
Restores ⲛⲣⲱⲟⲩ 'gates' — the gates of the ships opened inward.
6-char lacuna at line head with no surviving trace; could be the tail of the fifth-clause or a fresh connector. Insufficient constraint.
ⲁⲍⲥⲁⲩ preserved completes ⲙⲁⲍⲥⲁⲩ 'sixth'; ordinal pattern.
Partial ⲛⲉⲙ...ⲉ admits multiple readings (ⲛⲉⲙⲏⲏⲩⲉ 'with the heavens'? ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉ 'with the Up'?); the spiritual reading expects the gates' counterpart-object but the lexeme cannot be uniquely fixed.
Parallel formula from line 10 (ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲟⲩⲉⲛ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ); these gates are opened toward the Error as the boundary-fixing.
ⲁⲭ visible; Lyc ⲁϫⲛ̄/ⲁⲭⲛ̄ 'upon, against' — gates set against the Error.
Completes ⲙⲁⲍⲥⲁϣⲏ 'seventh' + predicative ⲡⲉ.

OVERRIDE of editor's 'Sin'. The spiritual reading explicitly identifies what the Third Ambassador discriminates as 'the captive light from its captors'. Sin/lust belongs to the archons (cf. {20}ⲃⲉ̄ = of Sin), not to what is extracted from them. The Light is what is separated forth.

ⲃⲉ̄ preserved completes ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ 'Sin'. The archons of Sin are the captors from whom the Light is extracted by the Third Ambassador's revelation. Lexicon: ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ as the cosmic principle of evil active in the archons.
Continues into line 15 ϣⲁⲙⲧ 'third' — 'of the Third Ambassador'.
ⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ preserved completes ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ; lexicon-fixed term ⲡⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲙ̄ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ 'Third Ambassador'.
Internal letters of ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ.
ⲉⲁⲩⲍⲉⲓⲉ 'after they fell' (Lyc) — ⲓ between ⲍⲉ and ⲉ completes the perfect stem ⲍⲉⲓⲉ.
ⲟⲩⲛ preserved completes ⲙⲁⲍϣⲙⲟⲩⲛ 'eighth'.
ⲭ[ⲉ ⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ]ⲱⲏ 'because the night' — ⲱⲏ preserved completes ⲧⲟⲩⲱⲏ.
4-char tail after ⲡⲱⲣⲭ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ; could be a locative (ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩ) or reciprocal (ⲛⲛⲉⲩⲉⲣⲏⲩ truncated), but no anchor — too weak to commit.
Bridges ⲍⲟⲩⲍⲉ 'abortions' and ⲍⲉⲓⲉ̄ 'fell' — ⲛ̄ⲍⲟⲩⲍⲉ ⲍⲉⲓⲉ̄ 'the abortions fell'.
Completes ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ 'downward' — the abortions ejected to the lowest natural.
ⲙⲏⲧ preserved completes ⲙⲁⲍⲙⲏⲧ 'tenth'.
ⲥⲙⲟⲥ preserved; lexicon ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ 'metensomatosis'.
ⲉ preserved completes ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'come to be, be instituted'.
ⲍⲛ̄ preposition 'in' — closing image: 'in the Zone'.
ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ — feminine article + Greek loanword for the cosmic Zone (lexicon).
